text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Abnormal ELB connection behavior observed in lon1 (eu-west-2) — spike in 502/504s from target group tg-backend-embed-01. Detected at 2026-03-17T10:03:30Z.

oncall-ops: I'm paged, looking now.

alice: seeing ~12% 5xx for the last 5m across edge ELBs in lon1, upstream errors from targets 10.15.32.4/10.15.32.5.

bob: confirming from metrics: request latency also increasing p95 -> 1.2s, healthy hosts dropping in TG from 8 -> 4 in last 4m.

sre-lead: tagging for priority P1. Start incident bridge. Who owns Route53 routing?

alice: starting quick triage: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:lon1:tg-backend-embed-01` — showing several Unhealthy target states with ``Target timed out``.

bob: pulling host logs: `grep -E "worker panic|OOM|accept failed" /var/log/app/*.log | tail -n 200` — nothing obvious, but connections are piling up.

sre-lead: check kernel metrics on those hosts (conntrack, SYN backlog).

oncall-ops: on it, `ss -s` shows large number of SYN_RECV on 10.15.32.5. conntrack entries high ~180k.

support-lead: support ticker influx: ~7 customer reports (prod impact) — highest is AcmeCorp experiencing increased request failures to embeddings endpoint.

alice: quick mitigation plan proposal: 1) drain problematic targets from target group, 2) temporarily shift 40% of Route53 weight to fallback region (us-west-2) for embeddings route, 3) scale up replacement hosts in lon1 ASG and monitor.

bob: agree. Draining now: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=10.15.32.5` then set admin drain on instance.

incident-bot: Deploy notification: `autoscaler` triggered +2 instances in lon1 ASG at 10:12Z (automated).

sre-lead: proceed with Route53 weight shift — use low TTL and incremental change. Who will run the change?

oncall-ops: I will. Preparing change: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://shift-40pct.json` — will roll 10% -> 40% stepwise every 2m.

support-lead: drafting customer comms for statuspage: "We are investigating increased error rates for embeddings in EU (lon1). Temporary failover to US is in progress; some customers may see requests routed to a different region." Need ETA for first update in 15m.

alice: after first drain, health checks improved on remaining hosts, 5xx dropped to ~6% and connection queue reduced.

bob: after second drain and a small weight shift (10%): errors down to 3.2%, p95 latency 800ms.

oncall-ops: Route53 change completed: weights now 40% -> us-west-2 for embeddings.production.redwood.ai, TTL set to 30s.

statusbot: Status page updated: Incident "Embedding service degraded (lon1)" — we are mitigating by shifting traffic and replacing unhealthy instances.

sre-lead: estimation: 25-40% of traffic served from fallback region; customer-impact limited to occasional higher latency for those routed to us-west-2. No data plane degradation beyond that.

support-lead: calling out customers with dedicated endpoints: AcmeCorp and BetaBank saw errors; I'm opening high-priority tickets and will page their CSMs.

alice: scaling events finishing, new hosts bootstrapped and passing healthchecks (3 new healthy). Will incrementally reintroduce to TG once stable.

bob: note — root cause likely conntrack exhaustion + increased accept latency on a kernel upgrade that rolled earlier today. Filing RCA pointer, but short-term mitigation complete.

sre-lead: Good work. Next steps: keep weights pinned for 30m, observe error rate <1% target, then gradually shift back once TG stabilizes. Prepare postmortem and note change window matching.

oncall-ops: handing off to night oncall @charlie in 20m — will leave runbook and current state: weights=40% us-west-2, 6/8 healthy in lon1 TG, new instances healthy, tickets opened.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident bridged closed for active mitigation — watch mode. If errors exceed 5% re-escalate.

support-lead: posting to #customers: "We've mitigated major errors by routing some traffic to an alternate region; engineers are replacing unhealthy hosts in London. We'll update when traffic returns to London"

sre-lead: add firewall/kernel tunables check to postmortem; pushing patch to AMI build to avoid auto-kernel roll without conntrack bump.

oncall-ops: handing off complete.

charlie: thanks, picking up watch. Please DM any urgent regressions.

support-lead: next status update scheduled in 15m.

incident-bot: [METRICS SNAPSHOT] pre-mitigation 5xx=12%, post-step1 5xx=3.2%, after drains+scale 5xx=0.9%.

sre-lead: closing active paging. Follow-up: postmortem owners alice+bob+oncall-ops, publish within 72 hours. :memo:
